text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby showed a stable performance 
in the Rose Stakes. However, after the 
race, an injury flared up in her right 
leg.

The doctor gives a diagnosis stating she 
will be fully recovered by the Shuka Sho. 
However, after consulting with her 
Trainer, they exercise caution and 
withdraw their goals for the remainder of 
the year.

Furthermore, moving up her schedule, she 
announced her switch to the sprint 
division. Facing a bustling press corps, 
she swore to become the new symbol of the 
"Grand Dynasty" in sprint races.

Meanwhile, Daitaku Helios learned of 
Daiichi Ruby's change in path. Her heart 
swelled with anticipation at the thought 
of competing against someone she cared 
about.

Daiichi Ruby embarks on her new mission. 
Her next goal is the Senior spring 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen, carrying the weight 
of a three-generation victory for her 
family.
